items.title: 15.2 Crystallization (crystals bana kar saaf karna) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 15.2 with the Keep in Mind box, printed pages 326-327.

blocks.text: Crystallization ka basic principle (usool) yeh hai ke solute kisi suitable solvent mein zyada temperature par hal ho jaye, aur jab solution ko thanda kiya jaye to extra (faltu) solute crystals ki shakal mein bahar nikal aaye. Crystallization ke process mein yeh steps hote hain.
